title: Sr. Program Manager - Cloud Transformation - Contract only - onsite/hybrid Kansas City, MO
description:
Title: Sr. Program Manager - Cloud Transformation, Kansas City, MO
Contract - 6 moths to start
No Sponsorship
Hybrid

Requirements & Responsibilities:
  • Experience in leading Cloud Transformation projects - management and execution of Cloud Transformation
  • Lead all phases of the project lifecycle, including, but not limited to project plan creation, project kickoffs and internal status meetings, handling timeline, budget, achievements, and deliverables
  • Work with program team to identify risks, plan for risk response and mitigation and proactively monitor risks, issues and resolutions
  • Experience managing and leading delivery of product development-based programs and/or strategy-based programs, and develop strategic program plans
  • Proven experience with leading programs in an Agile (Scrum) and SAFe framework
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, including MS PowerPoint, MS Project and MS Visio
  • Experience with financial management is strongly preferred
  • Must be an effective communicator (written and verbal); effectively communicating program status, risks, scope, etc. to clients and strong decision-making, facilitation skills, and drive collaboration across teams
